identidade: a gentle satirical caricature of the Brazilian supreme court justice shown in the photos, recognizable at a glance: fully shaved bald head, thick straight dark eyebrows, heavy eyelids, stern downturned mouth.
roupa: black judicial robe open at the front over a dark suit and white shirt with tie, wide cuffed sleeves, braided black cord at the chest; the robe ends just below the knee and is split in front so the legs move freely.
corpo: about 1.78 m, athletic and broad, thick neck, rigid upright posture; the widest shoulders of the political cast.
naoExagerar: no demonic or villain look, no bodybuilder arms, no giant head
